lib.title: Link in bio
lib.description: Pages for the link in your Instagram, TikTok or WhatsApp profile: products with live price and stock, collections, promo codes, articles, contact. Clicks are counted without cookies.
lib.empty: No page yet. Press “New page” to create one.
lib.clicksOff: Click counting is off in the plugin options.

credit.text: Link in bio by Haus Kayu

page.name: Internal name
page.localesHint: Codes separated by commas; the first is the default (e.g. id, en).
page.publishedHint: Unpublished pages answer 404 and their links stop working.
page.ogImageHint: Leave empty to let the storefront draw one from the avatar and the title.
page.title: Display name
page.utmOn: Add utm_source / utm_medium / utm_campaign to links
page.utmHint: Links that already carry UTM parameters are left alone.
page.deleteConfirm: Delete this page and all its items? Click counts are deleted too.
page.noStorefront: Set storefront.url in the plugin options to see the public address and QR codes.

item.empty: No links yet. Add a product, a collection, a promo code or any link.

typeHint.product: Shows the product's price for the visitor's region and whether it is in stock.
typeHint.promo: Visitors copy the code with one tap; add a link to open the shop with it.
typeHint.post: An article from the blog (medusa-blog-seo), or always the latest one.
typeHint.whatsapp: Opens a WhatsApp chat with a prefilled message.
typeHint.header: A heading between links. Only the label is shown.

item.label: Label
item.labelHint: Empty = the product's, collection's or article's own title.
item.imageHint: Empty = the product's or article's own image.
item.iconHint: An emoji or a Lucide icon name (e.g. instagram).
item.deleteConfirm: Remove this link? Its click counts are kept in the totals.

stats.title: Clicks
stats.privacy: Counted on the server without cookies; bots and visitors with Do Not Track are not counted.

errors.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://.
errors.invalid_handle: The handle may contain letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.handle_taken: That handle is already used by another page.
errors.invalid_locale: That language is not one of the page's languages.
errors.invalid_date: Check the dates: the end must come after the start.
